english.title: Keep a dangerous wild animal without a licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) kept a dangerous wild animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), other than under the authority of a licence granted in accordance with the provisions of the Dangerous Wild Animals Act 1976 by a local authority
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) and 2(5) and 6 of the Dangerous Wild Animals Act 1976.
